title: Why Do Obese People With Alzheimer’s Live Longer? - Nautilus
gist: A study of Health and Retirement Study data (1998-2022, 4,500+ people aged 51+) found that being overweight or obese at Alzheimer's diagnosis was associated with 16-27% lower mortality risk, extending the 'obesity paradox' seen in kidney, pulmonary embolism and cardiovascular patients.

insights.claim: Although obesity is a risk factor for many health problems, obese individuals diagnosed with kidney disease, pulmonary embolisms and cardiovascular disorders show a reduced risk of dying, a pattern called the obesity paradox.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Complicates simple narratives that weight loss always improves outcomes, relevant to obesity-drug and insurer mortality models.
insights.quote: obese individuals diagnosed with kidney disease, pulmonary embolisms, cardiovascular disorders, and more have a reduced risk of dying
insights.locator: There’s a bit of a mystery

insights.claim: Public health researchers analysed Health and Retirement Study data from 1998 to 2022 covering more than 4,500 Alzheimer's-free people aged 51 and older, and found those obese at Alzheimer's diagnosis were less likely to die.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Long-run cohort data extends the obesity paradox to dementia, a major healthcare cost driver.
insights.quote: examining health data dating from 1998 to 2022 from more than 4,500 Alzheimer’s-free people 51 and older enrolled in the Health and Retirement Study
insights.locator: Public health researchers made the discovery

insights.claim: Among Alzheimer's patients, overweight individuals (BMI 25-29.9) had a 16% lower mortality risk, class 1 obese (BMI 30-34.9) 27% lower, and class 2-3 obese (BMI 35+) 22% lower.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: The non-linear benefit peaking at class 1 obesity matters for survival modelling in long-term care and dementia therapeutics.
insights.quote: those with class 1 obesity (BMI of 30 to 34.9) had a 27 percent lower risk
insights.locator: Public health researchers made the discovery
